changes: Chest bomb uses 40% linear scale; held bomb stays full size, raised and offset to keep the keypad clear of the gripping palm. Both hands supported.
Bomb and purchased tweezers follow the pouch hip heading and torso lean, with the existing headset-based fallback. Tweezers remain visible on the weapon-hand chest side.

Weapon-hand grip draws chest equipment and temporarily stashes the equipped gun. Grip release stows the equipment and restores the gun. Use explicitly drops a held VR bomb; recovery equips its chest slot.
Cutting requires a fresh weapon-hand trigger press with the tweezer tip at a wire.
Turn-stick and wheel grenade selection set a separate shoulder preference and leave the gun equipped. Offhand shoulder Grip + Trigger actually draws the selected grenade.

Keypad contact uses the rendered free-hand index fingertip, measured keycap boxes with a 5 mm fingertip radius, front-face crossing and withdrawal before each new press. Invalid or distant tracked tips are rejected.
Avatars without index finger bones temporarily use the visible tracked glove and hide only the replaced avatar hand. Fingertip skin offsets are cached per model.

live_test.later_focus_note: Runtime subsequently reported focus loss; input and gaze pause normally while unfocused.

limits: In-headset comfort and reach await user feedback; automated contact checks and native rendering passed.
The fovea desktop visualization and unlimited purchases are isolated to ignored, export-excluded live test fixtures.
Existing third-party UID fallback and shutdown resource warnings remain; no script or runtime errors occurred in the focused validation.
